Details: Due to high Forecast Unscheduled Operational Demand across the SWIS, AEMO is forecasting potential Low Reserve Conditions (LRC) for the peak period on 09/06/2026, 16:30 - 20:30. This is based on the High scenario load forecast, as a result of forecast high conditions.The forecast condition level is Lack of Reserve 1 (LOR1).Market Participants are advised that should this LRC Declaration period eventuate:AEMO intervention may be required if Electric Storage Resource (ESR) facilities have an insufficient state of charge (SOC) as deemed by AEMO in advance of the specified peak period.All generation Facilities may receive a Dispatch Instruction.Facilities offering Essential System Services may be trapped at Enablement Maximum limits.Demand Side Programmes may receive a Dispatch Instruction for maximum curtailment capacity.Supplementary Capacity (SC) may be dispatched.Peak Demand Non-Co-Optimised Essential System Services may be activated.AEMO may take further actions to manage Power System Security and Reliability as required.
Actions by AEMO: AEMO may intervene (which constitutes an AEMO Intervention Event) and direct Participants to update Real-Time Market Submissions (RTMS) to resolve market shortfalls and maintain Power System Security and Reliability if:AEMO determines shortfalls are persistent and not resolved by the prescribed time which may lead to a Satisfactory (and Not-Secure) Operating State.Sufficient capacity is not committed In-Service (with allowance for Start Decision Cutoff).Facilities are trapped at Enablement Maximum limits.ESR facilities are at an insufficient state of charge (SOC) as deemed by AEMO before the prescribed time.AEMO will provide updates of any significant changes or amendments to the forecast Low Reserve Conditions.
Mandatory Actions by Market Participant: Ensure compliance with this Market Advisory & follow all Directions and Dispatch Instructions issued by AEMO.
Optional Actions by Market Participant o: MP: Monitor forecast Pre-Dispatch and Dispatch Market Schedules, and where Energy Market shortfalls are forecast, and a Facility is trapped at its high enablement limit with further energy capacity available, update Real-Time Market Submissions to prevent Trapezium Trapping.NO: No action required.Please call AEMO on 1300 989 797 (Option 1) if further information is required.
